content.text:
Here are the **best laptop deals I found online for U.S. shoppers** as of **May 31, 2026**. Prices can change quickly, so confirm before checking out.

## Best overall deal

**Dell 16 Plus — $899.99, save $530**  
Specs: Intel Core Ultra 7 256V, 16GB LPDDR5X RAM, 1TB SSD, 16-inch 2.5K display, Intel Arc graphics.  
Why it’s good: strong all-around productivity laptop with a sharp screen and a large SSD. Best fit for school, office work, multitasking, light creative work, and long-term use. Dell lists it at **$899.99 vs. $1,429.99 estimated value**. ([dell.com](https://www.dell.com/en-us/shop/deals/pc-laptop-deals?msockid=2486a006cb2f6ee830d7b66ccac46f9a&utm_source=openai))

## Best budget Windows deal

**Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 15.6" — $579.99, save $170**  
Specs: AMD Ryzen 7 5825U, 16GB RAM, 512GB SSD, 15.6-inch FHD touchscreen.  
Why it’s good: very solid specs under $600, especially because it has **16GB RAM** rather than the 8GB often found at this price. Best Buy shows it as a Memorial Day deal at **$579.99**. ([bestbuy.com](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/searchpage.jsp?id=pcat17071&st=laptops+16gb+memory&utm_source=openai))

## Best cheap performance pick

**Dell 15.6" 2K Touchscreen Laptop — $599.99, save $400**  
Specs: Intel Core i7-1355U, 16GB RAM, 512GB SSD, 15.6-inch 2K touchscreen.  
Why it’s good: excellent CPU/RAM/screen combo for the price. Good for students, work-from-home, browsing with lots of tabs, Office apps, and video calls. Best Buy lists it as a limited-time deal at **$599.99**. ([bestbuy.com](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/searchpage.jsp?id=pcat17071&st=laptop+16+gb+ram+512+ssd+memory+core+i7%5C&utm_source=openai))

## Best 2-in-1 / touchscreen deal

**HP OmniBook X Flip 14" — $649.99, save $300**  
Specs: Intel Core Ultra 5 226V, 16GB RAM, 512GB SSD, 14-inch 2K touchscreen, Copilot+ PC.  
Why it’s good: good pick if you want a convertible laptop/tablet design with a modern chip and a sharper-than-FHD display. Best Buy lists it as a Memorial Day deal at **$649.99**. ([bestbuy.com](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/searchpage.jsp?_dyncharset=UTF-8&browsedCategory=pcmcat138500050001&id=pcat17071&iht=n&ks=960&list=y&qp=percentdiscount_facet%3DDiscount~30%25+Off+or+More%5Esystemmemoryram_facet%3DRAM~16+gigabytes&sc=Global&st=categoryid%24pcmcat138500050001&type=page&usc=All+Categories&utm_source=openai))

## Best larger-screen value

**Dell 16 Plus — alternate configuration shown at $799.99**  
Dell’s deals page also surfaced another Dell 16 Plus configuration at **$799.99 vs. $1,349.99**, though you’ll want to verify the exact configuration before buying because retailer pages can show multiple configs under the same model family. ([dell.com](https://www.dell.com/en-us/shop/deals/pc-laptop-deals?msockid=2486a006cb2f6ee830d7b66ccac46f9a&utm_source=openai))

## Quick buying advice

If you want the safest pick, get the **Dell 16 Plus at $899.99**. If you want the best value under $600, I’d choose between the **Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 at $579.99** and the **Dell i7 2K touchscreen at $599.99**. For most people, avoid laptops with **8GB RAM** unless they’re very cheap Chromebooks or only for basic browsing.

My top 3 picks:

1. **Dell 16 Plus — $899.99**: best overall.
2. **Dell 15.6" i7/16GB/512GB — $599.99**: best performance-per-dollar.
3. **HP OmniBook X Flip — $649.99**: best 2-in-1 deal.
